title: Ball-Codifference Screening for Heavy-Tailed Predictors
summary: High-dimensional screening is commonly built on covariance, correlation, or least-squares measures. These summary measures can be unstable or even undefined, when predictors are sparse or have heavy-tailed distributions. Building on our recent work on extended codifference and the idea of Ball-covariance, we develop Ball-codifference for marginal screening in statistical modeling with heavy-tailed predictors and responses.
